raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MEX-SustainableValueChains",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Substantial environmental and social risks across sub-projects financed through financial intermediaries under ESS9.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply NAFIN and PFI Environmental and Social Management Systems, enforce a ring-fenced Exclusion List, perform due diligence on subprojects, and conduct World Bank sample verification.",
      "evidence": "Environmental and Social Risk Classification Substantial"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "SMEs and mid-cap firms lack internal technical capacity and knowledge to measure emissions, prepare bankable green projects, and comply with MRV frameworks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide firm-level technical assistance under Component 2, including funding for feasibility studies, market assessments, and support for preparing Sustainability Plans.",
      "evidence": "Most Mexican firms lack the capacity to measure emissions, implement energy-use, generation or management systems, and comply with reporting frameworks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Participating Financial Institutions and NAFIN face capacity constraints in designing, originating, appraising, and monitoring green and sustainability-linked loan products.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide structured capacity building and technical assistance to PFIs and NAFIN, including guidance documents, templates, calculation tools, and digital monitoring systems.",
      "evidence": "Mexican financial institutions are limited in their capacity to design, originate, appraise and monitor green loans and sustainable finance products."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Low demand or limited uptake of SLL and GL products by beneficiary enterprises due to transaction costs, administrative complexity, and uncertain payback periods.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Offer time-bound step-down pricing incentives, deploy direct technical assistance to lower transaction costs, and partner with anchor companies and industry associations to generate demand.",
      "evidence": "mitigate the risk of a situation where financing is available, but uptake is limited."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Risk of greenwashing or non-credible performance claims in Sustainability-Linked Sub-loans and Green Sub-loans.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate ex-ante validation of Sustainability Plans and ex-post verification of key performance indicators and targets by qualified, independent validation entities.",
      "evidence": "To mitigate the risk of greenwashing, targets and results in the SP will be subject to... ex-ante validation and ex-post verification"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Extreme weather events and climate hazards (droughts, floods, heatwaves) could cause operational disruptions and increase loan delinquency rates among beneficiary enterprises.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize sub-project financing for energy reliability, water efficiency, and climate resilience technologies while embedding climate risk assessments in sub-loan appraisal.",
      "evidence": "Extreme temperatures have been shown to raise loan delinquency rates among Mexican firms"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Foreign exchange risk exposure on NAFIN's balance sheet resulting from borrowing in USD and on-lending primarily in MXN.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Manage currency exposure using local currency swap markets and limit USD sub-lending strictly to beneficiary enterprises with explicit natural export hedges.",
      "evidence": "NAFIN will manage the FX risk on its own balance sheet using Mexico’s well developed currency swap market."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Credit and default risk exposure assumed by NAFIN on direct mid-cap sub-loans and on credit lines to Participating Financial Institutions.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain robust credit risk margins, enforce PFI financial soundness criteria, set single-borrower exposure limits, and require minimum co-financing from borrowers and PFIs.",
      "evidence": "NAFIN will assume the credit risk of the BEs when lending directly and of the PFIs on second-tier operations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "NAFIN procurement staff lack direct experience in executing selection and contracting processes under World Bank Procurement Regulations.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Assign a dedicated internal procurement professional, receive hands-on training from the World Bank, and implement close Bank oversight for initial procurement packages.",
      "evidence": "while NAFIN staff are familiar with the World Bank Procurement Regulations, they have not been directly involved in carrying out selection and contracting processes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Financial management efficiency constraints and operational risks arising from reliance on legacy information systems requiring manual data consolidation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce established internal control mechanisms, perform regular supervisory reviews and reconciliations, and execute targeted internal audit coverage detailed in the POM.",
      "evidence": "efficiency constraints arising from reliance on legacy information systems requiring manual consolidation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Exclusion of Mexican SMEs and mid-caps from global value chains due to non-compliance with strict corporate Scope 3 emissions and sustainability standards.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide tailored long-tenor financing and targeted TA to help firms adopt renewable energy, energy efficiency, and verified sustainability plans aligned with global anchor requirements.",
      "evidence": "Firms that do not comply risk forward-exclusion from supply chains, with implications for sales and employment"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Potential delays to project effectiveness from required fulfillment of legal effectiveness conditions, including adoption of the POM and Sustainable Finance Framework.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize grant funds from the Grant Facility for Project Preparation (GFPP) to advance preparation and adoption of the POM and Sustainable Finance Framework prior to effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "The Additional Conditions of Effectiveness consist of... adoption of the Project Operations Manual... and Sustainable Finance Framework"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Shallow local financial market conditions and short average SME loan tenors restrict private bank lending for long-term sustainability investments.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide long-tenor IBRD and CCEFCF blended credit lines through NAFIN and PFIs with explicit minimum maturity rules established in the POM.",
      "evidence": "SME loans are mostly provided for short-term, working-capital purposes, with the average SME loan-tenor less than two years."
    }
  ]
}
